name: press-release-list
title: Press release list
description: Your own announcements by year: headline, date and optional PDF per row, with the company boilerplate and the media contact in sticky cards beside them.
docs: Pass releases with an ISO dateTime: the year groups and the order (newest first) come from it, and a dateTime with a time is filed under the year it falls in timeZone, the same day the row shows. date is the short form shown in the row; leave it out and dateTime is written with locale. A release without pdfHref has no download link, and the PDF link is named by what it fetches: Download, the headline, PDF and the size. The boilerplate and contact cards are optional and sit beside the list from 1024px, held in view below --sticky-top (6rem by default; set it to the height of your sticky header) on screens at least 46rem tall, so a short laptop screen never cuts them off; without them the list takes the full width. Only the copy button is a client component, so the block works in a Server Component. Pass labels to translate the fixed words and linkAs={Link} to route the release links.
